title: Discovery of natural RORgammat inhibitor using machine learning, virtual screening, and in vivo validation.
authors: Yoo, Hojin; Han, Sang-Jun; Lee, Jeong-Eun; Cho, Chaeyeon; Hong, Donggyun; Jeong, Birang; Kim, Sijin; Jung, Go-Yeon; Ma, Minjeong; Jung, Soeun; Park, Beomjun; Lee, Namgil; Yoo, Hee-Seop; Cho, Kwang-Jin; Seo, Min-Duk; Chung, Yeonseok; Kim, Byung-Seok; Yang, Heejung
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习虚拟筛选、分子对接和MD发现天然RORgammat抑制剂，虽涉及转录因子但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA结合，方法可迁移但非本课题核心。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gamma t (RORgammat) is a crucial transcription factor regulating Th17 cells, which secrete the cytokine IL-17. RORgammat inhibitors are regarded as a therapeutic modality in a wide range of autoimmunity including psoriasis. OBJECTIVES: The objective of the study is to investigate novel RORgammat inhibitors from natural products (NPs), combining machine learning (ML)-based virtual screening, chemotaxonomic analysis, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations, and biological validation. METHODS: This study employed an integrated approach combining ML-based ligand-based screening, docking study, molecular simulation, and chemotaxonomic analysis to identify RORgammat inhibitors from NPs. RESULTS: ML ensemble models predicted potential RORgammat inhibitors from an NP library; subsequent chemotaxonomic classification of top-ranked hits prioritized protoberberine alkaloids. Six protoberberine alkaloids, which are predicted to bind RORgammat via docking studies, were selected for experimental validation. Among them, berberine (Ber) and coptisine (Cop) potently inhibited Th17 differentiation in vitro. Surface plasmon resonance analysis demonstrated that both Ber and Cop directly bind to RORgammat, with Cop exhibiting a stronger affinity for RORgammat than Ber. Moreover, Cop demonstrated therapeutic efficacy in a preclinical mouse model of psoriasis. These results validate an integrated workflow, combining ML, chemotaxonomy, and experimental testing in vitro and in vivo, for the efficient discovery of novel RORgammat inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 引言：维甲酸相关孤儿受体γt（RORgammat）是调控Th17细胞的关键转录因子，Th17细胞分泌细胞因子IL-17。RORgammat抑制剂被视为包括银屑病在内的多种自身免疫疾病的治疗手段。目的：本研究旨在结合基于机器学习（ML）的虚拟筛选、化学分类学分析、分子对接、分子动力学模拟及生物学验证，从天然产物（NPs）中发掘新型RORgammat抑制剂。方法：本研究采用整合方法，结合基于ML的配体筛选、对接研究、分子模拟及化学分类学分析，从NPs中识别RORgammat抑制剂。结果：ML集成模型从NP库中预测了潜在的RORgammat抑制剂；随后对排名靠前的命中化合物进行化学分类学分类，优先筛选出原小檗碱类生物碱。通过对接研究预测可结合RORgammat的六种原小檗碱类生物碱被选用于实验验证。其中，小檗碱（Ber）和黄连碱（Cop）在体外有效抑制Th17分化。表面等离子体共振分析表明，Ber和Cop均直接结合RORgammat，且Cop对RORgammat的亲和力强于Ber。此外，Cop在银屑病临床前小鼠模型中显示出治疗效果。这些结果验证了一种整合工作流程，结合ML、化学分类学及体外和体内实验测试，可高效发现新型RORgammat抑制剂。
